hero.title: Mechanical Engineering (PG) in Mauritius for Indian Students
paras: A Master’s in Mechanical Engineering is a postgraduate qualification for students interested in advanced mechanical systems, machine design, manufacturing, thermal engineering, energy systems and industrial technology. It can help graduates deepen their engineering knowledge and prepare for specialist technical or research-oriented careers. For Indian applicants exploring a **Master’s in Mechanical Engineering in Mauritius for Indian Students**, comparing available postgraduate programmes and their specialisations is an important first step.

overview: Important course availability note: The University of Mauritius’s published postgraduate programme list for 2026–2027 does not list a dedicated MSc or Master’s in Mechanical Engineering. It offers related programmes, including MSc Building Services Engineering, MSc Sustainable Energy Engineering with Environmental Management, and MSc Total Quality Management and Performance Excellence. These are related options, not equivalent qualifications in Mechanical Engineering.

items.q: Can Indian students apply for Mechanical Engineering (PG) in Mauritius?
items.a: Yes, Indian students meeting the academic criteria and English proficiency requirements can apply to recognized Mauritian institutions.

items.q: What is the medium of instruction for Mechanical Engineering (PG) in Mauritius?
items.a: Programmes at major Mauritian universities are delivered in English, with bilingual options available at select institutions.

items.q: What are the typical tuition fees for Mechanical Engineering (PG) in Mauritius?
items.a: Tuition fees generally range between MUR 150,000 and MUR 350,000 per year, offering cost-effective international degree options.

items.q: Is a student visa required for Indian students?
items.a: Yes, international students require an entry permit and student visa issued by the Passport and Immigration Office of Mauritius upon receiving admission.
